references.text: The children of Gad and Reuben give the same promise earlier in the chapter, where they say they will do as their lord commands.
The children of Gad and Reuben confirm their willingness to cross the Jordan armed before the Lord, just as Moses said.
Moses sets out the conditions that the children of Gad and Reuben now confirm they will follow.
Moses reminds the tribes of their promise to go armed ahead of their brothers, the Israelites.
The children of Gad and Reuben confirm to Joshua that they will do everything he commands them, just as they promised Moses.
Joshua confirms that the children of Gad and Reuben have kept their promise and done what the Lord commanded through Moses.
The people of Israel answer in a similar way at Sinai: 'All that the Lord has said, we will do.'
The people answer again that they will do everything the Lord has said and be obedient.
